title: Crossing the Belt
text: An asteroid belt lies across your path. There are tumbling rocks the size of cities, and gaps you can't see until you're in them.

choices.text: Let the Pilot thread a gap.

outcomes.result: Clean through with a scrape or two.
A rock clips the cargo spine. It could have been worse.

choices.text: Navigate it yourself.

outcomes.result: Luck is on your side. Not a scratch.
A bad call. Metal screams down the length of the ship.

choices.text: Hire a Ceres tug to tow you through.
choices.result: Expensive, boring and safe.

choices.text: Take the long way around.
choices.result: Three days of detour, but not a scratch.

title: Through the Comet's Tail
text: A comet's tail stretches across your course: a river of ice and grit. The ice could be melted into oxygen, but the grit is moving fast.

choices.text: Have the Scientist time a pass through the thin edge.
choices.result: Perfect timing. The scoops fill with clean ice.

choices.text: Fly straight through and scoop ice.

outcomes.result: The hull is pitted, but the tanks are full of fresh ice.
A storm of grit sandblasts the forward plating.

choices.text: Wait for it to drift past.
choices.result: Two days watching it glitter by.

title: Ion Storm
text: Purple lightning crawls across a storm front the width of a solar system. Your instruments are already flickering.

choices.text: Shut everything down and ride it out.
choices.result: Two days in the dark, listening to the hull crackle.

choices.text: Punch through at full burn.
choices.hint: fast, but it may fry systems

outcomes.result: You're through, smoking but whole.
A bolt fries the main bus. Sparks everywhere.

choices.text: Ground the hull and push through.
choices.result: Lightning crawls harmlessly over the grounded hull. A few plates are scorched, nothing more.

title: Pirate Picket
text: Two pirate cutters hang across the only safe lane. "Cargo inspection," they call it. Their guns say otherwise.

choices.text: Let them take a cut of the food stores.
choices.result: They take their cut and wave you on, laughing.

choices.text: Have Security put on a show of force.

outcomes.result: They decide you're more trouble than you're worth.
They call your bluff. A short, ugly firefight.

choices.text: Run for it at overdrive.

outcomes.result: You outrun them, engines screaming.
They rake your stern before you get clear.

title: The Twin Suns
text: Earth 2's twin stars bend space between you and the planet. You can slingshot around them, or burn the long way.

choices.text: Slingshot around the twin suns.

outcomes.result: The slingshot flings you toward Earth 2 with fuel to spare.
You cut it too close. The hull glows red.

choices.text: Let the Pilot plot a precise slingshot.
choices.result: A textbook manoeuvre. The crew applauds.

choices.text: Burn the long way around.
choices.result: Slow, costly and safe.

title: The Debris Halo
text: Earth 2 is ringed by the wreckage of an older, failed mission: satellites, tanks and torn solar sails, all orbiting fast.

choices.text: Let the Pilot weave through.
choices.result: Your pilot dances through the junk.

choices.text: Push through slowly with lights on full.

outcomes.result: A long, nervous crawl. Only small impacts.
A spinning fuel tank slams into the hull.

choices.text: Salvage what you can on the way.

outcomes.result: Old batteries and good parts. Someone else's loss.
A tether snaps and whips across the salvage team. Someone is badly hurt.

title: The Drifting Wreck
text: A colony ship like yours, dark and tumbling. Its name has been scorched off the hull, and its reactor is still flickering. Another crew that didn't make it.

choices.text: Send a salvage team.

outcomes.result: Their engine room is mostly intact.
Their stores were never touched. Someone died with full shelves.
The wreck's reactor flickers back to life and vents a burst of plasma.

choices.text: Send Security in first to sweep it.
choices.result: A careful sweep turns up a hidden strongbox too.

choices.text: Leave the dead in peace.
choices.result: You play their distress beacon's last message once, for respect.

title: The Abandoned Relay
text: A relay station, lights off, docking clamps open. Its last log entry reads: "Quarantine in effect."

choices.text: Dock and raid the storerooms.

outcomes.result: Sealed stores, still good. Nobody came back for them.
Whatever emptied this station is still in the air ducts.

choices.text: Have the Medic check for contagion first.
choices.result: The Medic clears one section. You take what's safe.

choices.text: Keep your distance.
choices.result: Some doors are closed for a reason.

title: Ghost Signal
text: A ship identical to yours is broadcasting your own call sign. When you hail it, it answers with your voice.

choices.text: Board it.

outcomes.result: Empty. Perfectly stocked. You take what you can and don't look back.
In the captain's chair you find a log in your handwriting. You burn it.

choices.text: Have the Scientist scan it from a distance.
choices.result: Some kind of sensor echo. The data alone is worth something.

choices.text: Fly past. Fast.
choices.result: It doesn't follow. You think.

title: The Silent Probe
text: A probe of no human design, smooth as river stone, drifting on your course. It is warm to the touch.

choices.text: Have the Scientist study it.
choices.result: Its surface carries a star map. One of the stars is Earth 2.

choices.text: Bring it aboard.

outcomes.result: It hums, and your batteries fill. Nobody can explain how.
It drains the ship's power for a day, then goes dark.

choices.text: Leave it be.
choices.result: It watches you go. Or seems to.

title: The Long Silence
text: Weeks without a signal from anyone. The crew has stopped talking at meals. Someone has started counting the rivets.

choices.text: Organise a talent night.
choices.result: Terrible juggling. A surprisingly good harmonica solo.

choices.text: Have the Scientist give stargazing lectures.
choices.result: Turns out the dark isn't empty at all.

choices.text: Let them cope in their own way.
choices.result: The silence gets deeper.

title: A Rogue Planet
text: A starless world drifts through the dark, its ice glowing faintly. There's frozen fuel and water down there, if you dare to land a shuttle.

choices.text: Send a mining shuttle down.

outcomes.result: Two days of hard work, and the tanks are fuller.
An ice shelf collapses under the shuttle. Everyone gets out, barely.

choices.text: Have the Pilot skim the atmosphere for gas.
choices.result: A bumpy dive, but the scoops come up full.

choices.text: Keep flying.
choices.result: It fades behind you, alone forever.

title: The Lost Colony Beacon
text: A beacon from the first Earth 2 expedition, the one that never arrived. It marks a supply cache, and a warning.

choices.text: Recover the cache.
choices.result: Old ration bricks and a spare part, frozen in time.

choices.text: Play their final message to the crew.
choices.result: "Whoever hears this: finish what we started." Nobody speaks for a while.

choices.text: Have the Engineer strip the beacon's power cells.
choices.result: Practical. Some of the crew think it's grave-robbing.

title: The Haven's Toll
text: Three gunships flank you on approach. "Docking fee is a hundred credits, friend. Non-negotiable."

choices.text: Pay the toll.
choices.result: "Pleasure doing business."

choices.text: Have Security stare them down.

outcomes.result: "...Fine. First one's free."
They don't like your face. Warning shots, then a smaller fee.

choices.text: Refuse and dock anyway.

outcomes.result: They clamp your ship and take what they like from your account.
They shoot first. You dock with a fresh scorch mark.

title: Inspection
text: The Waystation's brothers ask to inspect your cargo before docking. Politely, but firmly. The sealed crates are still in your hold.

choices.text: Offer a generous donation to the monastery.
choices.result: They bless your ship and don't open the crates.

choices.text: Have Security talk your way through.

outcomes.result: "Medical supplies," you say. They believe you.
They open a crate. You pay a heavy fine.

choices.text: Confess and hand over the crates.
choices.result: They confiscate the crates and fine you. The crew seems relieved.
